## Procedure

1. **Set the depth with the Micrometer Nut ("F"):** Each graduation on the nut indicates .001" of depth. It reads directly against a scale mounted along its side. [Mill (Bridgeport)]

2. **Use the Quill Stop Knob ("E"):** This is used to disengage the automatic feed in either direction and to set the working depth stop point. Depths are obtained by setting the micrometer nut in conjunction with the quill stop. [Mill (Bridgeport)]

## Using Automatic Feed for Depth Control

When using the automatic quill feed:

1. Ensure the quill lock is off.
2. Set the micrometer dial ("H") to the required depth.
3. Engage the auto quill feed ("D") when the motor has stopped.
4. Select the feed rate and feed direction.
5. Engage the feed trip lever ("E") — the feed will **automatically trip out** at a depth within .010" (.25mm) of the set depth.
6. **Hand feed to the dead stop** for repeatable accuracy of .001" (.025mm). [Mill (Bridgeport)]

> **Note:** The feed control lever ("I") must be engaged in order to use manual feed controls. [Mill (Bridgeport)]
